# Innovation Built Around Real Healthcare Needs

AliMed has always been shaped by a simple idea: better solutions start with understanding the
everyday challenges of caregivers, patients, and healthcare facilities. From value-based products
designed to support safety and productivity to new materials that help improve comfort, durability,
and performance, our innovation is rooted in practical solutions for all care environments.

everyday challenges of caregivers, patients, and healthcare facilities. From value-based products
designed to support safety and productivity to new materials that help improve comfort, durability,
and performance, our innovation is rooted in practical solutions for all care environments.

stability and performance.

features a floating seal and stability wings.

  Our businesses bring together leading technologies, innovative solutions and hands-on expertise to

  Take a look at our list of businesses.
  
  [ Our Businesses ][52]
  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

setting.]

### [ Biopharma Capabilities ][130]

[A person in a yellow shirt and gray cardigan holds a smartphone and a pill bottle, with a child in
the background.]

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow
ottoman and a glass of water are in the background.]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur
emphasizing fast movement.]
Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

When you’re shopping for medical supplies, the last thing you want to do is navigate multiple
stores, fight against budget restraints, and deal with complicated pickup or delivery requirements.
At Vitality Medical, we work hard to take the stress out of purchasing medical supplies, letting you
worry less about your purchase and more about the health of you or your loved one.
* ## Delivering Quality and Reliability
  
  Vitality Medical stands out as a leading online destination for discount medical supplies and
  equipment, offering over 100,000 products from reputable brands. Since 2000, over 2.5 million
  customers have trusted Vitality Medical for their healthcare needs, conveniently browsing and
  purchasing a wide range of medical supplies online. This has made Vitality Medical a go-to source
  for both consumers and resellers. Our commitment to quality and service is recognized by top
  ratings, including an [**A+ from the Better Business Bureau**][98] and a [**4.2-star rating on
  Google**][99]. Discover more about our success on [**Bloomberg**][100] or [**Inc. 5000**][101],
  and read [**testimonials**][102] on [**Trustpilot**][103] and [**Reseller Ratings**][104].
* ## Committed to Affordable Medical Supplies
  
  At Vitality Medical, affordability and quality go hand in hand. Our product experts are dedicated
  to helping customers find medical supplies online that fits both their needs and their budgets.
  We’re committed to offering the best prices. **If you find a lower price elsewhere, we'll match
  it**. Our national network of warehouses, stocked with top-tier brands, guarantees fast and
  reliable shipping. Many of these warehouses are strategically located near major metropolitan
  areas, ensuring that your medical supplies arrive quickly and cost-effectively, right when you
  need them. Sign up for our newsletter to stay informed about exclusive sales and promotions. We
  regularly offer discounts on both innovative new products and everyday essentials.
* ## Why Choose Vitality Medical
  
  Navigating the world of home medical supplies can be overwhelming. Vitality Medical is here to
  guide you every step of the way. Our customer service team receives regular training to ensure
  they can answer all your product-related questions. If an item is out of stock, our team will go
  the extra mile to find it, underscoring our commitment to helping you **Add Vitality to Your
  Life**.
  
  For purchasing agents in hospitals, caregiver facilities, or retail, our [Business to
  Business][105] section offers tailored solutions and information to meet your specific needs.
  
  When you choose Vitality Medical as your online medical supply store, you’re choosing convenience,
  dependability, and expertise. Explore our products today to find the equipment you need. You can
  also [contact our team][106] to learn more about our products, get help navigating our
  collections, and make an informed, confident purchase.

  ###### Happy Customers
  
  See our customer testimonials or our excellent customer reviews on Trustpilot, Reseller ratings

When you’re shopping for medical supplies, the last thing you want to do is navigate multiple
stores, fight against budget restraints, and deal with complicated pickup or delivery requirements.
At Vitality Medical, we work hard to take the stress out of purchasing medical supplies, letting you
worry less about your purchase and more about the health of you or your loved one.
* ## Delivering Quality and Reliability
  
  Vitality Medical stands out as a leading online destination for discount medical supplies and
  equipment, offering over 100,000 products from reputable brands. Since 2000, over 2.5 million
  customers have trusted Vitality Medical for their healthcare needs, conveniently browsing and
  purchasing a wide range of medical supplies online. This has made Vitality Medical a go-to source
  for both consumers and resellers. Our commitment to quality and service is recognized by top
  ratings, including an [**A+ from the Better Business Bureau**][98] and a [**4.2-star rating on
  Google**][99]. Discover more about our success on [**Bloomberg**][100] or [**Inc. 5000**][101],
  and read [**testimonials**][102] on [**Trustpilot**][103] and [**Reseller Ratings**][104].
* ## Committed to Affordable Medical Supplies
  
  At Vitality Medical, affordability and quality go hand in hand. Our product experts are dedicated
  to helping customers find medical supplies online that fits both their needs and their budgets.
  We’re committed to offering the best prices. **If you find a lower price elsewhere, we'll match
  it**. Our national network of warehouses, stocked with top-tier brands, guarantees fast and
  reliable shipping. Many of these warehouses are strategically located near major metropolitan
  areas, ensuring that your medical supplies arrive quickly and cost-effectively, right when you
  need them. Sign up for our newsletter to stay informed about exclusive sales and promotions. We
  regularly offer discounts on both innovative new products and everyday essentials.
* ## Why Choose Vitality Medical
  
  Navigating the world of home medical supplies can be overwhelming. Vitality Medical is here to
  guide you every step of the way. Our customer service team receives regular training to ensure
  they can answer all your product-related questions. If an item is out of stock, our team will go
  the extra mile to find it, underscoring our commitment to helping you **Add Vitality to Your
  Life**.
  
  For purchasing agents in hospitals, caregiver facilities, or retail, our [Business to
  Business][105] section offers tailored solutions and information to meet your specific needs.
  
  When you choose Vitality Medical as your online medical supply store, you’re choosing convenience,
  dependability, and expertise. Explore our products today to find the equipment you need. You can
  also [contact our team][106] to learn more about our products, get help navigating our
  collections, and make an informed, confident purchase.

# Practical HVAC Learning and Engineering Support

Learn HVAC through structured courses, articles, videos, and training, or get professional
engineering support for HVAC design, review, documentation, and selected site assessment work.

[Start Learning HVAC][19][Get Engineering Support][20]

*Founded by a Malaysian MBOT Professional Technologist, HRD Corp TTT certified trainer, certified
iCxS, and HVAC practitioner with 10+ years of field experience.*

## What Do You Need Help With?

[Graduation Hat 1]

### I Want to Learn HVAC

Build HVAC knowledge through online courses, membership, corporate training, mentorship, articles,
and videos.

[Explore Learning Paths][21]
[Briefcase 2]

### I Want HVAC Engineering Support

Get support for HVAC advisory, project review, design documentation, troubleshooting, and selected
site assessment work.

[View Engineering Services][22]

## Explore Free HVAC Guides and Videos

Start with practical HVAC articles and videos covering air conditioning basics, chilled water
systems, cooling load calculation, psychrometrics, duct design, troubleshooting, and energy
efficiency.

[Browse HVAC Articles][23][Watch HVAC Videos][24]
* **HVAC Basics**
  For beginners who want to understand systems, components, and terminology.
* **Chilled Water Systems**
  For engineers, facility teams, and contractors working with chillers, pumps, cooling towers, and
  CHW systems.
* **Cooling Load & Design**
  For learners who want to understand load calculation, equipment sizing, and design workflow.
* **Psychrometrics & Air Side Systems**
  For people learning humidity, air properties, AHU behavior, ductwork, and air distribution.
* **Troubleshooting & Field Lessons**
  For people who want to understand real HVAC problems, site observations, and performance issues.

## Learn HVAC Through the Format That Fits You

Whether you want self-paced learning, company training, or personal guidance, the HVAC Learning Hub
helps you choose the right path.

1
Online Courses

Self-paced HVAC courses for focused or continuous learning. Choose individual courses, Basic
membership, or Pro membership depending on your goal.

[View Online Courses][25]
2
Corporate Training

Practical HVAC training for companies, contractors, facility teams, and technical departments in
Malaysia, with HRD Corp claimable options where applicable.

[Request Corporate Training][26]
3
1-to-1 Mentorship

One-to-one personalized HVAC guidance for learners who want help with technical topics and
questions, career direction, or project-related learning.

[Explore Membership][27]

## Popular HVAC Courses

Structured courses designed to help you move from basic understanding to practical HVAC design
knowledge.
* **HVAC Beginner Course**
  Learn HVAC fundamentals, major systems, components, and practical terminology.
* **RTS Cooling Load Calculation**
  Learn cooling load calculation using the Radiant Time Series method.
* **Psychrometric Analysis**
  Understand humidity, air properties, psychrometric processes, and HVAC air treatment.
* **Duct Design**
  Learn duct sizing, layout logic, airflow, pressure loss, and practical air distribution design.
* **Chilled Water System Design**
  Learn chilled water system design, flow rate, equipment selection, system configuration, and
  design considerations.

[View All Courses][28]

## Need HVAC Engineering Support?

For selected projects and enquiries, I provide practical HVAC advisory, design documentation, and
Malaysia-based on-site assessment support.

[View All Engineering Services][29]

## HVAC Advisory / Consultation

For second opinions, contractor quotation review, proposal review, layout questions, and technical
advice.

## HVAC Design & Documentation

For layout drawings, system sizing, duct routing, equipment selection, BQ, and preliminary design
documents.

## On-Site Assessment / Troubleshoot

For Malaysia-based site visits, logger installation, field assessment, troubleshooting, and
practical system diagnosis.

Arabian Ethicals was established in 1977 to deliver specialized premium pharmaceuticals, veterinary
medicines, consumer care and cosmetic solutions to the UAE’s growing and evolving healthcare
marketplace.

With decades of experience, we provide end-to-end medical-supply and pharmaceutical-distribution

We operate across pharmaceuticals, consumer health, veterinary, and medical-supply sectors, serving

Do you offer distribution in other GCC countries as well?

healthcare and pharmaceutical growth.

Brands can reach out via our contact page to explore partnership, distribution, and market-entry

### Help from NHS 111

If you're worried about a symptom and not sure what help you need, NHS 111 can tell you what to do
next.

Go to [111.nhs.uk][20] or [call 111][21].

For a life-threatening emergency call 999.

## Featured
* ### [ Book a COVID-19 vaccination appointment ][22]
  
  If you're eligible for the spring COVID-19 vaccine, you can book a vaccination appointment now
* ### [ Get healthcare cover abroad with a UK GHIC or EHIC ][23]
  
  Get or renew your health insurance card to help you get healthcare in the EU and some other
  countries
* ### [ Refer yourself for help for back and joint problems ][24]
  
  Get NHS help from community musculoskeletal (MSK) services, like physiotherapy, for back and joint
  problems

## More information and advice
* ## [Vaccinations][25]
  
  Information about vaccinations for babies, children and adults, including why they're important
  and how to get them
* ## [COVID-19][26]
  
  Advice about COVID-19, including symptoms, treatments and how to avoid catching and spreading it.

* ## [Women's health][28]

## About the ERN Conference

The **Emerging Researchers National (ERN) Conference in Science, Technology, Engineering and
Mathematics (STEM)** is hosted by the [American Association for the Advancement of Science
(AAAS)][31], [Center for STEMM Education and Workforce (CSEW) Programs][32] and the [National
Science Foundation (NSF) Directorate for STEM Education (EDU][33]) and is in alignment with updated
2026 NSF priorities. The conference is aimed at providing professional development for all college
and university undergraduate and graduate students, studying any STEMM discipline, including
minorities, persons with disabilities and women.

The objectives of the conference are to help undergraduate and graduate students to enhance their
science communication skills and to better understand how to prepare for science careers in a global
workforce. Towards this end, the general format for the 2.5-day conference will include:
* Student STEM Research Poster and Oral presentations
* Plenary Sessions featuring STEM Leaders
* Exhibit Halls featuring universities, graduate programs, organizations, and more

Other conference activities include workshops focused on:
* Strategies for applying for and succeeding in graduate programs and finding funding for graduate
  school;
* Career preparation workshops focused on employment searches and retention; and
* Understanding STEM careers in a global context and identifying international research and
  education opportunities for undergraduate and graduate students and faculty.

## ERN 2027

The 2027 Emerging Researchers National (ERN) Conference in STEM will be held in **Atlanta, Georgia**
on **Thursday, March 4th – Saturday, 6th, 2027** at the [Hyatt Regency Atlanta][34] (265 Peachtree
Rd NE, Atlanta, GA 30303). The conference will begin with the opening plenary session on Thursday,
March 4, and conclude on Saturday, March 6. Click below for ERN 2027 registration details.

[About the 2027 ERN Conference][35]

## 2027 ERN Conference

The 2027 Emerging Researchers National (ERN) Conference in STEM will be held in **Atlanta,
Georgia** on **Thursday, March 4th – Saturday, March 6th, 2027** at the [Hyatt Regency Atlanta][36].
Registration and student submission dates **To Be Announced!**

## About the ERN Conference

The **Emerging Researchers National (ERN) Conference in Science, Technology, Engineering and
Mathematics (STEM)** is hosted by the [American Association for the Advancement of Science
(AAAS)][31], [Center for STEMM Education and Workforce (CSEW) Programs][32] and the [National
Science Foundation (NSF) Directorate for STEM Education (EDU][33]) and is in alignment with updated
2026 NSF priorities. The conference is aimed at providing professional development for all college
and university undergraduate and graduate students, studying any STEMM discipline, including
minorities, persons with disabilities and women.

The objectives of the conference are to help undergraduate and graduate students to enhance their
science communication skills and to better understand how to prepare for science careers in a global
workforce. Towards this end, the general format for the 2.5-day conference will include:
* Student STEM Research Poster and Oral presentations
* Plenary Sessions featuring STEM Leaders
* Exhibit Halls featuring universities, graduate programs, organizations, and more

Other conference activities include workshops focused on:
* Strategies for applying for and succeeding in graduate programs and finding funding for graduate
  school;
* Career preparation workshops focused on employment searches and retention; and
* Understanding STEM careers in a global context and identifying international research and
  education opportunities for undergraduate and graduate students and faculty.

on **Thursday, March 4th – Saturday, 6th, 2027** at the [Hyatt Regency Atlanta][34] (265 Peachtree

March 4, and conclude on Saturday, March 6. Click below for ERN 2027 registration details.

## About Us

# India’s Leading Medical Equipments Manufacturers & Exporters

GST Corporation Limited (**GSTC**) is one of India’s leading Medical Equipments Manufacturers &
Exporters, with more than six decades of dedication in providing trusted & reliable medical
solutions worldwide since 1959. Based in New Delhi, we are into surgical equipments, rehabilitation
aids, orthopedic implants, and** FDA-approved medical disposables **with the highest international
standard.

 

## **Global Reach. Certified Quality.**

With the support of FDA, CE, EAR,  ISO 9001:2015, and ISO 13485:2016 certifications,GSTC has
established a good reputation for high quality, best manufacturing, and conformance to regulations.
Hospitals, clinics, non-governmental organizations, and tender authorities in over 65 nations across
the globe, including the USA, Canada, Europe, Middle East, Africa, Southeast Asia, and Latin
America, accept our products in the majority of cases. We are among the leading exporters of medical
devices from India.

 

## **Trusted by Governments, NGOs & Global Health Missions**

GSTC has developed long-term alliances with over 400 customers, including **UNICEF, UNDP, the World
Bank, **and **government health ministries** and international tendering authorities of different
countries. We stand as one of** India’s leading medical equipments manufacturers & exporters ** that
have international certifications and are renowned for our dependability in **OEM cooperation **with
top international companies.

 

### **What We Offer**
* **Top-quality surgical instruments from India**
* **The best orthopedic implants available for export**
* **FDA certified medical disposables in bulk**
* **Customizable OEM solutions for global healthcare projects**
* **Specialized products for gynecology, [anesthesia][31], emergency care, ICU, and diagnostics**

Whether you’re a private healthcare provider, institutional buyer, or sourcing agency, GSTC ensures
**on-time delivery, consistent quality, and global compliance** every step of the way.

### ** Why Choose GSTC?**
* **60+ years of manufacturing excellence**
* **Exporting to 65+ countries and expanding**
* **Certified by CE, FDA, ISO 13485**
* **Comprehensive product range across key medical categories**
* **Dedicated OEM/private labeling for global brands**
* **Proven track record with humanitarian and development agencies**
* As the medical equipments manufacturers & exporters, GSTC continues to innovate, expand, and raise
  the bar for affordable, certified medical devices worldwide.

## About Us

# India’s Leading Medical Equipments Manufacturers & Exporters

GST Corporation Limited (**GSTC**) is one of India’s leading Medical Equipments Manufacturers &
Exporters, with more than six decades of dedication in providing trusted & reliable medical
solutions worldwide since 1959. Based in New Delhi, we are into surgical equipments, rehabilitation
aids, orthopedic implants, and** FDA-approved medical disposables **with the highest international
standard.

 

## **Global Reach. Certified Quality.**

With the support of FDA, CE, EAR,  ISO 9001:2015, and ISO 13485:2016 certifications,GSTC has
established a good reputation for high quality, best manufacturing, and conformance to regulations.
Hospitals, clinics, non-governmental organizations, and tender authorities in over 65 nations across
the globe, including the USA, Canada, Europe, Middle East, Africa, Southeast Asia, and Latin
America, accept our products in the majority of cases. We are among the leading exporters of medical
devices from India.

 

## **Trusted by Governments, NGOs & Global Health Missions**

GSTC has developed long-term alliances with over 400 customers, including **UNICEF, UNDP, the World
Bank, **and **government health ministries** and international tendering authorities of different
countries. We stand as one of** India’s leading medical equipments manufacturers & exporters ** that
have international certifications and are renowned for our dependability in **OEM cooperation **with
top international companies.

 

### **What We Offer**
* **Top-quality surgical instruments from India**
* **The best orthopedic implants available for export**
* **FDA certified medical disposables in bulk**
* **Customizable OEM solutions for global healthcare projects**
* **Specialized products for gynecology, [anesthesia][31], emergency care, ICU, and diagnostics**

Whether you’re a private healthcare provider, institutional buyer, or sourcing agency, GSTC ensures
**on-time delivery, consistent quality, and global compliance** every step of the way.

### ** Why Choose GSTC?**
* **60+ years of manufacturing excellence**
* **Exporting to 65+ countries and expanding**
* **Certified by CE, FDA, ISO 13485**
* **Comprehensive product range across key medical categories**
* **Dedicated OEM/private labeling for global brands**
* **Proven track record with humanitarian and development agencies**
* As the medical equipments manufacturers & exporters, GSTC continues to innovate, expand, and raise
  the bar for affordable, certified medical devices worldwide.

## Công cụ tính thuế nhập khẩu hàng hóa

Áp dụng cho Việt Nam. Người dùng nhập **Trị giá tính thuế** đã quy đổi. Công cụ hỗ trợ Thuế NK, VAT
và các thuế khác (TTĐB, chống bán phá giá, tự vệ, BVMT theo số lượng, và % khác). Kết quả làm tròn
đến **đồng**.

Mô tả hàng
Trị giá tính thuế *
Thuế NK %
VAT %
Chống bán phá giá %

Tự vệ %

TTĐB %

Khác %
BVMT: Số lượng hàng bị tính thuế
BVMT: Thuế BVMT/đv (VND)

Thêm dòng Xóa dòng Tính Xóa kết quả
**Công thức:**

    Thuế nhập khẩu phải nộp = Trị giá tính thuế nhập khẩu x Thuế suất thuế nhập khẩu
    
Trị giá tính thuế nhập khẩu = Tiền hàng + cước vận chuyển quốc tế theo điều kiện giao hàng + các kho
ản phải cộng/chi phí phát sinh cho đến cảng nhập.
    
Thuế tiêu thụ đặc biệt = Trị giá tính thuế thuế tiêu thụ đặc biệt x Thuế suất = (Trị giá tính thuế n
k + thuế nk) x % TTĐB
    
Thuế chống bán phá giá = Trị giá tính thuế thuế chống bán phá giá x Thuế suất thuế chống bán phá giá
    
Thuế bảo vệ môi trường = Trị giá tính thuế x Thuế bảo vệ môi trường = Số lượng hàng x Thuế suất tuyệ
t đối
    VAT = (Trị giá tính thuế nk + thuế nk + thuế nk bổ sung + Thuế BVMT + Thuế TTĐB) * %VAT

## Công cụ tính thuế nhập khẩu hàng hóa

Áp dụng cho Việt Nam. Người dùng nhập **Trị giá tính thuế** đã quy đổi. Công cụ hỗ trợ Thuế NK, VAT
và các thuế khác (TTĐB, chống bán phá giá, tự vệ, BVMT theo số lượng, và % khác). Kết quả làm tròn
đến **đồng**.

Mô tả hàng
Trị giá tính thuế *
Thuế NK %
VAT %
Chống bán phá giá %

Tự vệ %

TTĐB %

Khác %
BVMT: Số lượng hàng bị tính thuế
BVMT: Thuế BVMT/đv (VND)

Thêm dòng Xóa dòng Tính Xóa kết quả
**Công thức:**

    Thuế nhập khẩu phải nộp = Trị giá tính thuế nhập khẩu x Thuế suất thuế nhập khẩu
    
Trị giá tính thuế nhập khẩu = Tiền hàng + cước vận chuyển quốc tế theo điều kiện giao hàng + các kho
ản phải cộng/chi phí phát sinh cho đến cảng nhập.
    
Thuế tiêu thụ đặc biệt = Trị giá tính thuế thuế tiêu thụ đặc biệt x Thuế suất = (Trị giá tính thuế n
k + thuế nk) x % TTĐB
    
Thuế chống bán phá giá = Trị giá tính thuế thuế chống bán phá giá x Thuế suất thuế chống bán phá giá
    
Thuế bảo vệ môi trường = Trị giá tính thuế x Thuế bảo vệ môi trường = Số lượng hàng x Thuế suất tuyệ
t đối
    VAT = (Trị giá tính thuế nk + thuế nk + thuế nk bổ sung + Thuế BVMT + Thuế TTĐB) * %VAT

Thuế NK %

**Công thức:**

ản phải cộng/chi phí phát sinh cho đến cảng nhập.

k + thuế nk) x % TTĐB
    
Thuế chống bán phá giá = Trị giá tính thuế thuế chống bán phá giá x Thuế suất thuế chống bán phá giá
    
Thuế bảo vệ môi trường = Trị giá tính thuế x Thuế bảo vệ môi trường = Số lượng hàng x Thuế suất tuyệ
t đối
    VAT = (Trị giá tính thuế nk + thuế nk + thuế nk bổ sung + Thuế BVMT + Thuế TTĐB) * %VAT

### [Medical Consumables][54]

#### Medical Consumables

HTSY® is a professional China medical consumables manufacturer and supplier. We support wholesale
services at factory prices with CE and ISO13485 certifications. Buy them from us for reliable,
high-quality healthcare essentials.



## How to select the best medical consumables for your clinic or hospital needs?

We know that in healthcare places, this kind of product include many single-use or disposable items.
These items are key for patient treatment, checks, cleanliness, and stopping infections. They cover
airway tools, suction devices, filters, masks, and more. All are made for low cost, safety rules,
and easy use every day.



We make our products from medical-grade materials like PVC or silicone. This gives good fit with the
body and strength. They help with safe work and cut risks like allergies or mistakes. Medical
consumables are very important in breathing and sleep drug areas. They help with safe airway work,
clearing fluids, and air flow. They reduce infection risks and make work faster in places from
surgery rooms to care units. Disposable types keep things clean and quick without reusing tools.



As a manufacturer, HTSY® uses a good research and development team with much field knowledge and new
ideas. This team helps us make and produce a big list of medical consumables on our own. The list

## Для чого потрібен рекуператор

### Що вирішує рекуператор

**Вентиляція з мінімальними втратами тепла**
Економте гроші завдяки ефективному збереженню тепла під час вентиляції в холодний період.

**Покращення самопочуття**
Безперервний повітрообмін забезпечує оптимальний рівень вуглекислого газу (CO₂), що покращує
здоров’я та працездатність.

**Чисте повітря без забрудників та неприємних запахів**
Повітря очищується від небезпечних для здоров’я летких органічних сполук (VOC).

**Відсутність плісняви в приміщенні**
Цвілеві грибки не зможуть існувати в умовах завжди свіжого повітря та відсутності духоти.

### Принцип роботи рекуператора

Система вентиляції повітря «Klimatronik 160» використовує протитічний теплообмінник, який забезпечує
одночасну роботу притоку та витяжки без змішування повітряних потоків. Пристрій витягує
«відпрацьоване» повітря з приміщення разом з дрібним пилом та димом і одночасно нагнітає вуличне
свіже, очищене та нагріте повітря. Нагрівання відбувається завдяки ефективному мідному
теплообміннику, який здійснює передачу тепла між повітряними потоками. Мідь при цьому є природним
антисептиком.

Таким чином у холодний період року тепле відпрацьоване повітря з приміщення видаляється витяжним
потоком і передає своє тепло зустрічному потоку свіжого повітря. У теплий сезон система працює
аналогічно на збереження прохолоди у приміщенні.

## Автоматичний контроль
## якості повітря

Система Klimatronik оснащена датчиками якості повітря, які відслідковують рівень вуглекислого газу
та вміст шкідливих летких органічних сполук у приміщенні. Залежно від показів стану повітря пристрій

### Показник рівня CO₂

Виділення СО₂ (вуглекислого газу) в приміщенні відбувається в процесі дихання. Також СО₂ утворюється
в результаті горіння полум’я плити, каміну тощо.

Якість повітря в приміщеннях вважається найкращою, коли вміст вуглекислого газу не перевищує 400-600
ppm. При вмісті від 1000 ppm протягом тривалого часу людина починає відчувати дискомфорт. З
подальшим зростанням концентрації CO₂ посилюються відчуття задухи, втрата уваги, стрес, сонливість
та втома.

### Показник TVOC

Леткі органічні сполуки, або VOC (volatile organic compounds) – це хімічні речовини, що виділяються
у вигляді газу чи пари з твердих та рідких матеріалів навіть при кімнатній температурі. Термін
“TVOC” означає сумарний вміст цих речовин та використовується для оцінки забруднення повітря.
Концентрація багатьох VOC в приміщенні може бути до 10 разів вищою, ніж на відкритому повітрі. VOC
виділяються з тисяч різноманітних матеріалів, в т.ч. з фарб, штукатурки, декоративного покриття,
шпалер, лаків та іншої будівельної хімії. Також до VOC відносяться природний і чадний гази, складові
вихлопних газів і тютюнового диму. Одними з найбільш шкідливих та небезпечних VOC є бензол, фенол і
формальдегід. Високі концентрації VOC у повітрі викликають проблеми зі здоров’ям, особливо у дітей,
літніх людей, вагітних жінок, а також у тих, хто має алергію та астму.

[patient centered care icon]

We don’t just care for your health conditions. We care about you. That means [our providers][65]
take the time to listen to what’s important to you before recommending next steps.

[national recognition icon]

### National recognition:

Cleveland Clinic is recognized in the U.S. and throughout the world for its expertise and care.

[skilled and collaborative providers icon]

### Collaborative providers:

You’ll get care from board-certified and fellowship trained experts who work together to create a
treatment plan just for you. Only the highest standards ensure [excellent outcomes][66].

[Innovation and Research Icon]

### Innovation and research:

We’re focused on today — and tomorrow. Our focus on [research][67] and offering the latest options
means you can find a wide range of [clinical trials][68] and other care that you can’t find
elsewhere.

## For Providers

Explore a curated collection of helpful resources and tools for medical professionals

### Institutes & Departments

Connect with expert teams across our [Institutes and Departments][91] to collaborate on patient care
and drive better outcomes.

### Join Our Nursing Team

Whether you’re just graduating from nursing school or have years of experience, you can build an
exceptional career in [nursing at Cleveland Clinic][92].

### Careers

As one of the nation’s — and the world’s — leading academic medical centers, you can grow in a
setting where you’ll make a difference. [Find your career][93] at Cleveland Clinic.

### Refer a Patient

We welcome the opportunity to partner with you in caring for your patients. Our dedicated [Referring
Physician team][94] is available from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. EST every day for you and your patients.

### ConsultQD

A [site for physicians and healthcare professionals][95] from Cleveland Clinic. Discover the latest
research insights, innovations and treatment trends.

### Education

We’re dedicated to training the next generation of healthcare professionals. Explore the [training
and education programs][96] we offer worldwide.

### Research

We’re committed to improving care and finding tomorrow’s cures. Learn about our [cutting-edge basic,
translational and clinical research][97].

DrConnect, and MyPractice.

### Leadership

Saved industry jobs and over $30B with device tax repeal

### Mission

Accelerating patient access and improving health outcomes

### Network

Hundreds of companies of all sizes championing MedTech innovation

“As our organization grows and seeks to continue improving patient care, MDMA has been the perfect
partner to help our team overcome regulatory and reimbursement challenges throughout the years.”

Laura Francis | Chief Executive Officer, SI-BONE

“As a past CEO of multiple companies over the years, MDMA has always been a great resource and
valuable partner in our efforts to improve patient outcomes.”

Doug Godshall | Chairman of the Board of Directors, Saluda Medical & Executive Chairman, Galvanize
Therapeutics

“I have been fortunate to lead both large and small companies, and no matter what policy challenges
they faced, I would always want MDMA to be our voice, advocate and partner. The active engagement
with MDMA and collaboration with fellow members is essential for companies of all sizes to improve
patient care and the innovation ecosystem.”

James (Jim) V. Mazzo | Executive Chairman, Neurotech

Join hundreds of companies of all sizes that are advancing medical technology innovation. Leverage
the network and resources of MDMA to make your voice heard in Washington, DC and beyond!

##### About Us

# Welcome to Ribbel International Limited

**The World's Leading Manufacturer of Surgical Blades & Foley Catheters**

[Ribbel International][13] Limited, founded in 1992, is one of India’s most trusted medical devices
manufacturers & internationally recognized in the medical devices industry for its high quality &
reliable products. Based in Haryana, we manufacture and globally export [Foley Balloon
Catheter][14], Surgical [Scalpel Blades][15], [Urine Bags][16], [Endotracheal Tubes][17] and
[Prefilled Saline Flush Syringes][18].

We have over 30 years of experience and distribution in over 40 countries - With every product we
develop we make sure we add precision, safety and performance for the end user!

###### 30+ YearsExperience

###### 40+Export Countries

###### CertifiedQuality

###### TrustedBy Experts

##### Our Products

## Precision Engineered Medical Devices

[Foley Balloon Catheter]

##### Foley Balloon Catheter

Crafted for patient safety, our Foley Catheters are manufactured in high-grade medical silicone and
latex, engineered for easy insertion and minimal trauma.

[Know More][19]
[Scalpel Blades]

##### Scalpel Blades

Manufactured using precision German grinding machines from Solingen, our blades deliver unmatched
sharpness and durability trusted by surgeons globally.

[Know More][20]
[Urine Bags]

##### Urine Bags

Hygienic, leak-proof, and comfortable. Designed for use in hospitals, nursing homes, and for
post-operative care.

[Know More][21]
[Endotracheal Tubes]

##### Endotracheal Tubes

Available in plain and reinforced variants. Designed for effective airway management during surgery
and intensive care.

[Know More][22]
[Prefilled Saline Flush Syringes]

##### Prefilled Saline Flush Syringes

Sterile, pre-filled, single-use syringes with saline solution, reducing reflux and enhancing patient
safety in catheter maintenance.

[Know More][23]

##### Why Choose Ribbel?

### Built on Trust, Quality & Innovation

##### Global Quality Standards

We are certified by international medical standards, and have been relied upon by hospitals
worldwide.

##### State-of-the-Art Infrastructure

We have the latest machinery from Germany with an in-house R&D department and toolroom or workshop.

##### Massively Scalable Manufacturing

We manufacture over 100 million blades annually so fulfilling bulk requirements is no challenge.

##### Global Recognition

Our products are known and preferred by leading distributors and hospitals from Brazil to Saudi
Arabia.

[Learn More][24]

##### Quick Enquiry

### We’re Here to Help You

Have questions about our products or services? Our team is ready to assist you with the right
information and guidance. Just drop us a quick enquiry and we’ll get back to you shortly.

[Explore Products][25] [Contact Info][26]

In this modern age, there is no dearth of health issues. However, many of these health conditions
can be prevented by choosing a healthy lifestyle and consulting a doctor. Healthcare professionals
are working hard for the betterment of all. To support such professionals in providing great care to
patients, our company,** Saintroy Lifescience, **is working in the sector. With the help of years of
research, our company is concentrating on developing the most reliable, safe and effective
collection of** Anti Diabetic Tablets, Anti Fungal Tablets, Anti HIV Tablets, Anti Malarial
Medicines**, etc. It has the approval of many qualified experts of the medical field who vouch for
the quality and purity of our prepared pharmaceutical array. Everyday, we make use of finest
production machines, ensuring seamless formulation of our pharmaceutical collection. The entire
stock is prepared under utmost hygienic conditions to prevent any sort of contamination. As a proud
**manufacturer **and **supplier**, we never compromise on quality and showcase great adherence to
international standards.

## Smith+Nephew's top products

[ALLEVYN-LIFE-HERO-1-840x840-PX.png]

#### ALLEVYN^{◊} LIFE Foam Dressings

In a climate of growing expectations and budget restrictions,^{1-3} ALLEVYN LIFE Dressings may help
improve efficiency and patient satisfaction in community wound care,^{*4-7 }and have been shown to
support pressure injury prevention protocols^{8,9}
[ View product ][80]
[REGENETEN implant on RCR image from animation]

#### REGENETEN^{◊} Bioinductive Implant

Bioinductive collagen scaffold for tendon repair.^{1-3} Resorbed and replaced by new tendon-like
tissue within 6 months to support tendon healing.1,2,4-8
[ View product ][81]
[Hero 1 CORI Surgical System.png]

#### CORI^{◊} Surgical System

Combine your skill with handheld robotics and digital surgery applications across a range of joint
arthroplasty indications. Experience the power of one platform.
[ View product ][82]
[Tula Tympanostomy Kit]

#### Tula^{®} Tympanostomy System

An in-office alternative to traditional tympanostomy using a revolutionary, local anesthesia system
and an automated, 1-click tube delivery device.^{1,2}
[ View product ][83]
[Close up of EDGE, front]

#### RENASYS^{◊} EDGE Negative Pressure Wound Therapy System

The latest evolution in powerful RENASYS tNPWT features an improved user interface for enhanced
intuitiveness and simplicity, with a durable pump built to offer maintenance-free use^{*1-3}
[ View product ][84]
[41813 CARTIHEAL Product Page Hero Image V2]

#### CARTIHEAL^{◊} AGILI-C^{◊} Cartilage Repair Implant

A single-stage, off-the-shelf solution for knee cartilage and osteochondral defects, with or without
mild to moderate osteoarthritis (KL 0-3) comprised of a proprietary biomaterial that is porous and
biocompatible.
[ View product ][85]
[JOURNEYII_BCS_ROX_RoundPatella_AngledView_onWhite.png]

#### JOURNEY II^{◊} ROX^{◊} Total Knee Solution with CONCELOC^{◊} and OXINIUM^{◊} Technologies

Combining cemented and cementless technologies for a reverse hybrid approach, we bring to the stage
our latest and greatest in joint reconstruction
[ View product ][86]
[COR22-33747-V1-ProjectsAlchemy-AirwayMgmt-Hero-1122.png]

#### COBLATION^{◊} Technology for Airway Management

Designed for precise tissue removal^{1-5 }with a low thermal profile⁶
[ View product ][87]

## Transforming lives

Learn how our history and our passion drive us to strengthen, accelerate and transform the future of

## Wound Care

Smith+Nephew's Wound Care (Advanced Wound Management) portfolio provides comprehensive solutions to
meet broad and complex clinical needs and to help healthcare professionals reduce the human and
economic consequences of wounds.

[GettyImages-1448442087-CUT-OUT-SHAPE.png]

### Wound care indications

Acute, chronic and surgical wound indications, covering key considerations and common aetiologies
(such as inflammation, trauma or vascular deficiency) to help you build a treatment or prevention
plan to restore tissue integrity, reduce complications and promote healing.

[ View all ][88]

### Wound care products

A range of wound care products for targeted intervention on acute, chronic and surgical wounds based
on your patient’s needs and clinical strategy. Solutions range from core products for exudate
management and compression, through to advanced therapies for non-healing wounds and prevention of
infection via antimicrobial barriers.

[ View all ][89]

## Sports Medicine

From elite athletes to weekend warriors, everyone wants to get back to doing what they love after a
sporting injury. With our leading-edge technology, we help patients get back to living a Life
Unlimited.

[ Explore sports medicine ][90]
[Homepage Sports Medicine business unit teaser]

## Orthopaedic Reconstruction

Smith+Nephew's Orthopaedics portfolio includes an innovative range of hip and knee implants used to
replace diseased, damaged or worn joints, robotics-assisted and enabling technologies, and services
that empower surgeons. It also includes trauma products used to stabilise severe fractures and
correct bone deformities.

[ALLEVYN-LIFE-HERO-1-840x840-PX.png]

#### ALLEVYN^{◊} LIFE Foam Dressings

In a climate of growing expectations and budget restrictions,^{1-3} ALLEVYN LIFE Dressings may help
improve efficiency and patient satisfaction in community wound care,^{*4-7 }and have been shown to
support pressure injury prevention protocols^{8,9}
[ View product ][80]
[REGENETEN implant on RCR image from animation]

#### REGENETEN^{◊} Bioinductive Implant

Bioinductive collagen scaffold for tendon repair.^{1-3} Resorbed and replaced by new tendon-like
tissue within 6 months to support tendon healing.1,2,4-8
[ View product ][81]
[Hero 1 CORI Surgical System.png]

#### CORI^{◊} Surgical System

Combine your skill with handheld robotics and digital surgery applications across a range of joint
arthroplasty indications. Experience the power of one platform.
[ View product ][82]
[Tula Tympanostomy Kit]

#### Tula^{®} Tympanostomy System

An in-office alternative to traditional tympanostomy using a revolutionary, local anesthesia system
and an automated, 1-click tube delivery device.^{1,2}
[ View product ][83]
[Close up of EDGE, front]

#### RENASYS^{◊} EDGE Negative Pressure Wound Therapy System

The latest evolution in powerful RENASYS tNPWT features an improved user interface for enhanced
intuitiveness and simplicity, with a durable pump built to offer maintenance-free use^{*1-3}
[ View product ][84]
[41813 CARTIHEAL Product Page Hero Image V2]

#### CARTIHEAL^{◊} AGILI-C^{◊} Cartilage Repair Implant

A single-stage, off-the-shelf solution for knee cartilage and osteochondral defects, with or without
mild to moderate osteoarthritis (KL 0-3) comprised of a proprietary biomaterial that is porous and
biocompatible.
[ View product ][85]

Combining cemented and cementless technologies for a reverse hybrid approach, we bring to the stage
our latest and greatest in joint reconstruction

#### COBLATION^{◊} Technology for Airway Management

Designed for precise tissue removal^{1-5 }with a low thermal profile⁶

## Wound Care

Smith+Nephew's Wound Care (Advanced Wound Management) portfolio provides comprehensive solutions to
meet broad and complex clinical needs and to help healthcare professionals reduce the human and
economic consequences of wounds.

[GettyImages-1448442087-CUT-OUT-SHAPE.png]

### Wound care indications

Acute, chronic and surgical wound indications, covering key considerations and common aetiologies
(such as inflammation, trauma or vascular deficiency) to help you build a treatment or prevention
plan to restore tissue integrity, reduce complications and promote healing.

[ View all ][88]

### Wound care products

A range of wound care products for targeted intervention on acute, chronic and surgical wounds based
on your patient’s needs and clinical strategy. Solutions range from core products for exudate
management and compression, through to advanced therapies for non-healing wounds and prevention of
infection via antimicrobial barriers.

[ View all ][89]

## Sports Medicine

From elite athletes to weekend warriors, everyone wants to get back to doing what they love after a
sporting injury. With our leading-edge technology, we help patients get back to living a Life
Unlimited.

[ Explore sports medicine ][90]
[Homepage Sports Medicine business unit teaser]

## Orthopaedic Reconstruction

Smith+Nephew's Orthopaedics portfolio includes an innovative range of hip and knee implants used to
replace diseased, damaged or worn joints, robotics-assisted and enabling technologies, and services
that empower surgeons. It also includes trauma products used to stabilise severe fractures and
correct bone deformities.

  * * * #### Alliance – Entrepreneur

        commercialization, market access or growth can leverage our Alliance Program for a dedicated
        focus on an under-performing product or category.
        
        [Learn More >][6]

        Enterprises (MBEs) and can offer more adaptability, flexibility, and balance as compared to
        a non-MBE supplier.
        
        [Learn More >][7]

        SourceMark is a recognized leader in offering innovative solutions as a master supplier for
        hospitals, health systems, pharmacies, ambulatory surgery centers, clinical laboratories,
        and physician offices throughout the United States.
        
        [Learn More >][8]

        From our laryngoscopes to endotracheal tubes, and dynamic stylets, our portfolio of
        comprehensive solutions adds up to a powerful offering that brings innovation to patient
        care while improving outcomes.
        
        [Learn More >][10]
    * * #### Infection Prevention
        
        Our infection prevention solutions target vulnerable areas within the patient and clinician
        care continuum to create a care system where no person’s health and well-being is harmed by
        preventable infection.
        
        [Learn More >][11]
    * * #### Surgical
        
        SourceMark surgical products combine quality, reliability, safety and simplicity to advance
        patient care and clinician engagement through their ease-of-use, utilization efficiencies
        and affordable cost-point.
        
        [Learn More >][12]
    * * #### Fire and EMS

        needs of emergency responders in any situation.

# About Us

Unique Medical Supplies has been actively trading since 2012, and enjoys having an envious growth
record in the Healthcare sector. After several years of trading we are proud of our reputation as a
leading wholesaler in the U.K. Unique Medical Supplies has worked hard to become a “preferred
supplier” to some national and corporate accounts. Some of our customers go on to supply these
products directly to medical clinics, Hospitals, Doctors, private clinics, pharmacies, and many
other licensed medical practices. We are committed to giving you a professional service, and
understand the importance of getting your Orders processed on time, with precision fulfilment and
delivered punctually.

Over the years our experienced buying Team have forged strong relationships with all our suppliers.
We only purchase market leading brands, sourced from reputable licensed manufacturers and authorised
Distributors within the European Union, and the UK. We are proud of our reputation as a leading
wholesaler in the U.K, we know how critical it is to maintain very high standards in this industry.
To protect our reputation we are very thorough with our supply chain, and as such, and without any
reservations Unique Medical Supplies guarantee All our products are 100% genuine and authentic.

We also have an extensive range of genuine Medical Devices, OTC and Consumable products supplied at
competitive prices. We regularly buy in large volumes, enabling us to purchase products at great
discounted prices.

Unique Medical Supplies are excited to be working closely with Harley Street Healthcare Clinic
(London), offering their specially formulated skin products. Harley Street Healthcare Clinic have
recently announced they are about to add several new lines of high quality healthcare products to
their portfolio. Due to our special relationship with Harley Street Healthcare Clinic we are able to
offer these products directly to you.

We are relentless in looking for and monitoring new innovative skincare products coming into the
market place. Which produce better and enhanced results due to improved technology and advanced
research, giving consumers the advantage of using the latest products without the need to have
abrasive or intrusive medical treatment to improve their wellbeing.

[Noise of a domestic fan: how to evaluate it?][89]

Noise is an inevitable companion of any device that contains a motor and moving parts. It especially
draws our attention in places where we seek peace and relaxation – in our homes and apartments. An
exhaust fan also operates with minimal sound level, which is specified in the device's user manual
and sometimes on the packaging. In the following, we will explain how to correctly interpret the
sound level of an exhaust fan and avoid misunderstandings when conducting your own sound level
measurements.

[Air pollution: what do we breathe in?][90]

Air pollution is one of the most severe environmental threats to human health today. The most
credible international organizations and media are constantly raising the issue. According to the
World Health Organization, one in three deaths of stroke, lung cancer, and heart diseases are caused
by the negative effects of polluted air, which is equivalent to the those of tobacco smoke. Are
there any solutions to reduce this impact on people's health and ameliorate the situation? Experts
give a positive answer to this question.

Endotracheal Tubes, Suction Catheter, Breathing Filter, Oxygen Mask, Anesthesia Mask, Stomach Tube,
Feeding tube etc. Kangyuan has passed ISO13485 quality system certification, products has passed EU
CE certification and US FDA certification.

In 2005 Kangyuan was founded , occupying one area of about 15,000 square meters, devoting an annual
output value of more than 170 million yuan RMB. With highly standardized producing line, more than
4,000 square meters of 100,000 class clean workshop, more than 300 square meters of

brand with science and technology; Create a social harmony by meeting the needs of patients” has
been strictly respected and carried out. The safety and quality of products is always being fully
guaranteed. After nearly 20 years of stable and sustainable development, Kangyuan has become one of
the largest medical consumables manufacturers in East China.

Haiyan Kangyuan Medical Instrument Co., Ltd. integrates R&D, production and sales, focuses on the
innovation of disposable and reusable medical consumables in polymer materials, has developed a full
range of products mainly in the fields of urology, anesthesiology and pneumatology, and
gastroenterology. The main products are: various Silicone Foley Catheters, Silicone Foley Catheter
with Temperature Probe, Suction-Evacuation Access Sheath for Single Use, Laryngeal Mask Airway,
Endotracheal Tubes, Suction Catheter, Breathing Filter, Oxygen Mask, Anesthesia Mask, Stomach Tube,
Feeding tube etc. Kangyuan has passed ISO13485 quality system certification, products has passed EU
CE certification and US FDA certification.
